results.question: How many days of annual leave do employees receive?
results.answer:
Employees receive 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Request annual leave in PeopleHub at least two weeks before your first day away. Your manager approves annual leave requests. [1]

Primary caregivers receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave. Secondary caregivers receive 6 weeks of paid parental leave. Contact the People team eight weeks before the planned start date. [2]

Report sick leave to your manager before 10:00 on your first day of absence. Record sick leave in PeopleHub. A medical certificate is required after three consecutive working days. [3]
